An Unwavering Vision: Building the Next Twenty Years of WisdomTree
Twenty years ago, WisdomTree launched with a simple belief: investors deserve better.

That belief shaped our approach to exchange-traded products (ETPs), challenged industry conventions, and established the foundation for what has become a global asset management platform. While our business has evolved dramatically over the past two decades, our vision has remained remarkably consistent: we believe that innovation should create better outcomes for investors, stronger businesses for our clients, and long-term value for our shareholders.

WisdomTree recently acquired Ceres Partners, an experienced asset manager with a focus on a high-growth $3.5 trillion U.S. farmland market, including exposure to adjacent verticals that include solar power, AI data infrastructure and water.
Visit Ceres Website Read the Press Release

Perry Vieth and Brandon Zick of Ceres Partners share the firm’s evolution into one of the leading farmland investment managers in the U.S. Now part of WisdomTree, Ceres continues its long-term focus on stewardship, value investing, and creating opportunity within the farmland asset class.
BY WILL PECK, HEAD OF DIGITAL ASSETS

WisdomTree is building an integrated stablecoin infrastructure — one that combines GAAP-compliant reserves, scalable onchain rails, and 24/7 liquidity. Learn how our full-stack approach is designed to support real-world payments, investing, and treasury management.
